paraphrase: Nārāyaṇa created the four-faced Brahmā, and the four-faced one, from his own face, created Śaṅkara; I have made this known in my antāti — let those who know take it to heart.
speaker: Tirumaḻicai Āḻvār

paraphrase: We learned the Śākya doctrine, we learned the Jain, we examined the scriptures made by Śaṅkara; by good fortune we reached the red-eyed dark Lord, and now nothing evil remains for us.
speaker: Tirumaḻicai Āḻvār
